content: Good morning, two tickets to London, please.
The regular ticket is 80 dollars while price of the express ticket is 10% higher.
I see, but how long does the express train take?
Comparatively, it can save you nearly an hour and the next one is leaving at 10:45.
Oh, we only have 15 minutes to go. But that's the time to catch the train. Besides, as long as I get to London earlier, I don't mind paying a little extra.
And in preference for the seat?
A window seat would be perfect. I always love to enjoy the view outside while taking the train.
No problem. Here is your ticket, wish you a pleasant trip.
